name: demo-webdriverio-javascript-for-nhs-wales
summary: A friendly demo of WebdriverIO browser automation with JavaScript, structured as a real Mocha test suite, testing three real user scenarios against the live NHS Wales website.
description: This repo drives a real Chrome browser with WebdriverIO against the live production https://www.nhs.wales/ website and asserts three things a real visitor would expect to see: the home page title, the About Us page's title and headline after clicking a link, and search results after using the search box. Each check is a real Mocha `it` test case with a real assertion, not a console.log statement.
